Off. Android does not limit the game processes. Stays only while the developer options are on.
Active. On this Android version it can only be switched off from a PC (ADB).

Active: Android may end game processes when all apps together have more than 32 child processes (the game needs about 10). To switch it off, first enable the developer options: under "About phone" tap "Build number" 7 times, then come back here.

Active: Android may end game processes when all apps together have more than 32 child processes (the game needs about 10). In the developer options, section "Apps", enable "Disable child process restrictions".

At most once a day, and after a crash, an anonymous message goes to Aptabase (servers in the EU): app and Android version, phone maker and model, total RAM (rounded), chip (SoC and CPU type), graphics chip with its OpenGL and Vulkan driver version, memory page size, audio output (buffer and sample rate) and whether the game\'s sound started, the result of the device check and the graphics path, refresh rate, language, some settings (frame rate, size, aim assist, resume, controller), play time and number of games, the game\'s memory use (after 10 minutes and at the end), and for your characters class, level (in steps of five), act, difficulty and hardcore; after a crash a fixed reason code, where the app was (installation, loading, game, app pages), how long it had run and the exit code. No names, no saves, no logs, no device ID, no serial number. Off: nothing is sent any more and what is waiting is deleted.

• Fire immune monsters (common in Hell) are hard to kill.\n• Little life, so keep your distance.\n• Needs mana potions.
• Frozen Armor gives defense early.\n• Warmth refills mana faster.\n• Gear with faster cast rate (FCR) and mana pays off.

• Cold slows almost everything.
• Ice Blast hits hard from level 6.
• From 24 Blizzard covers a whole area.
• Safer than fire, because monsters arrive slower.
• Cold immune monsters.\n• Blizzard hits moving targets less well.\n• Single targets only until level 24.
• Frost Nova frees you when monsters come too close.\n• Glacial Spike and Ice Bolt strengthen Blizzard.

• Double Throw hits from afar with two weapons at once.\n• Throwing Mastery raises damage and critical hits.\n• Safe distance from the monsters.
• Throwing weapons run out; Idle buys none yet.\n• Needs two good throwing weapons.\n• Weak against many monsters at once.
• Put a melee weapon on the second weapon slot.\n• Refill throwing weapons at a smith in town.
• War Cry hurts and stuns all monsters around him.\n• Howl, Taunt and Battle Cry raise its damage.\n• Battle Orders and Battle Command help the whole party.
• Needs a lot of mana, and the app puts no points into energy.\n• Only from level 30; until then Double Swing.\n• Little damage against single bosses.
• Stand among the monsters, War Cry hits all around.\n• Drink mana potions; items with mana help.
• Charged Strike hits one target with many bolts at once.\n• From level 30 Lightning Fury hits whole groups from afar.\n• Power Strike, Lightning Bolt and Lightning Strike raise the lightning damage.
• Lightning immune monsters (common in Hell).\n• Lightning Fury uses up javelins; Idle buys none yet.\n• Every throw costs mana.
• Jab and Power Strike carry her up to level 18.\n• Valkyrie and Decoy hold monsters off.\n• Replenish javelins at a smith in town.
• Multiple Shot hits whole groups early on.\n• From level 24 Strafe shoots at many monsters around her.\n• Guided Arrow never misses a single target.
• Arrows run out; Idle buys none yet and then uses Magic Arrow.\n• Needs a good bow and a lot of dexterity.\n• Little life, so keep your distance.
• Magic Arrow needs no arrows.\n• Valkyrie and Decoy draw the monsters away.\n• Pierce lets arrows fly through several monsters.
• Freezing Arrow freezes whole groups solid.\n• Cold Arrow and Ice Arrow raise its damage.\n• Frozen monsters do not hit back.
• Cold immune monsters.\n• Arrows run out; Idle buys none yet.\n• Freezing Arrow only from level 30.
• Ice Arrow is the main attack from level 18.\n• Valkyrie holds monsters off.\n• Magic Arrow helps when the arrows are gone.
• Chain Lightning jumps from monster to monster.\n• Lightning Mastery makes it very strong later on.\n• Static Field takes a part of the life of every monster around.
• Lightning immune monsters.\n• The lightning damage varies a lot.\n• Needs a lot of mana.
• Charged Bolt and Lightning carry her up to level 18.\n• Teleport gets you out of trouble.\n• Frozen Armor gives defense early.
• Frozen Orb sprays ice in all directions and hits whole groups.\n• Ice Bolt raises its damage.\n• Cold slows the monsters.
• Frozen Orb only from level 30; until then Ice Blast.\n• Cold immune monsters.\n• Many points go into Ice Bolt, which is weak on its own.
• Cast Frozen Orb into the middle of a group.\n• Frost Nova frees you when monsters come too close.\n• Teleport keeps the distance.
• An army of skeletons fights for him.\n• Skeleton Mastery makes them stronger.\n• Corpse Explosion clears whole groups.
• Skeletons need corpses to rise.\n• Idle cannot lead minions yet and only fights with Teeth.\n• Weak alone, without his army.
• Raise a skeleton from every corpse.\n• Amplify Damage and Decrepify help the army.\n• Clay Golem slows strong monsters.
• Poison Nova poisons all monsters around him.\n• Poison Dagger and Poison Explosion raise the poison damage.\n• The poison keeps hurting while he moves on.
• Poison immune monsters.\n• Poison takes a while to kill.\n• Idle casts no curses yet, so Lower Resist stays unused.
• Poison Dagger needs a dagger in the hand.\n• Lower Resist makes the poison much stronger.\n• Bone Armor absorbs hits.
• Blessed Hammer spirals around him and hits whole groups.\n• Magic damage: hardly any monster resists it.\n• Concentration, Blessed Aim and Vigor make it very strong.
• Only from level 18; until then melee with Might.\n• Needs a lot of mana, and the app puts no points into energy.\n• Idle does not keep the Concentration aura on yet.
• Put Concentration on the right-hand skill.\n• Holy Shield gives block and defense.\n• Stand in the group, the hammers circle around you.
• Zeal hits several times in a row, fast and accurate.\n• From level 30 Fanaticism raises attack speed and damage.\n• Needs little mana.
• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Needs a good weapon.\n• Idle does not keep the aura on yet.
• Put Fanaticism (before level 30 Might) on the right-hand skill.\n• Sacrifice raises the damage of Zeal.\n• A weapon with life steal helps.
• Vengeance adds fire, cold and lightning to every blow.\n• From level 30 Conviction lowers the resistances of the monsters.\n• Good against monsters with one immunity.
• Many points go into the three resist auras.\n• Every blow costs mana.\n• Idle does not keep the aura on yet.
• Put Conviction on the right-hand skill.\n• Zeal carries him up to level 18.\n• The resist auras also protect him.
• Tornado hits hard, and hardly any monster is immune (physical damage).\n• Hurricane hurts all monsters around him.\n• Cyclone Armor absorbs elemental damage.

• Tornado moves a little at random and misses at times.\n• Only from level 24; until then Arctic Blast and Twister.\n• The game does not report Hurricane and Cyclone Armor yet, so Idle does not renew them.
• Renew Cyclone Armor and Hurricane yourself.\n• Oak Sage gives more life.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• Fissure burns whole groups from level 12.\n• Volcano and Armageddon add fire and rocks.\n• Firestorm and Molten Boulder raise the fire damage.
• Fire immune monsters.\n• Fissure is slow against fast monsters.\n• The game does not report Armageddon yet, so Idle does not renew it.
• Cast Fissure under the monsters, not in front of them.\n• Keep Armageddon up yourself.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• As a werewolf he attacks very fast.\n• From level 30 Fury hits up to five times in a row.\n• Lycanthropy gives a lot of life.
• Idle cannot change shape yet and only attacks normally.\n• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Needs a good weapon.
• Change into the werewolf before each fight.\n• Feral Rage gives speed and life steal.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• Wolves and a Grizzly fight for him.\n• Oak Sage gives the whole pack more life.\n• Safe: the monsters attack the pets.
• Idle cannot lead minions yet and only attacks normally.\n• Slow killing on his own.\n• The pets get stuck in narrow places.
• Summon the wolves again after each death.\n• Carrion Vine and Solar Creeper help with life and mana.\n• Stay behind the pack.
• Lightning Sentry shoots many bolts at the monsters by itself.\n• From level 30 Death Sentry lets corpses explode.\n• Safe: the traps fight, she keeps the distance.
• Lightning immune monsters.\n• At most five traps at the same time.\n• Idle does not know yet that the traps fire by themselves.
• Lay traps near the monsters and step back.\n• Burst of Speed helps a lot.\n• Shadow Master fights alongside her.
• Dragon Talon kicks several times per attack.\n• Needs no charging, so it is simple to play.\n• The damage of the boots counts for the kicks.
• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Melee, so she stands among the monsters.\n• Needs good boots.
• Dragon Flight jumps to a target and kicks.\n• Fade and from level 30 Venom (poison on every kick) help a lot.\n• Shadow Master fights alongside her.
• Phoenix Strike charges up meteors, chain lightning and ice.\n• Three elements: hardly any monster resists them all.\n• Fists of Fire, Claws of Thunder and Blades of Ice raise its damage.
• Charging and finishing take practice.\n• Idle does not know combos yet and only attacks normally.\n• Phoenix Strike only from level 30.
• Charge up to three times, then finish with Dragon Talon.\n• Burst of Speed and Fade help a lot.
• Blade Fury throws blades at a target from afar.\n• Physical damage: hardly any monster is immune.\n• Blade Sentinel and Blade Shield add more blades.
• Single targets only.\n• Needs a lot of mana.\n• Only from level 18; until then Fire Blast.
• Hold the attack, the blades keep flying.\n• From level 30 Venom adds poison to every blade.\n• Burst of Speed and Fade help a lot.
